thesis: Jordi Visser states that his firm grew from just under $2 billion to $4 billion, with the majority of that growth occurring during the COVID period. He argues that while he has always believed interest rates would remain low, the current environment of lower-for-longer yields combined with high inflation and cost of living creates significant pressure on allocators.
